dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Rustam, you look terrible. What happened?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: You won't believe this. Yesterday was a disaster.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: OK. So I had arranged to present my research project to Professor Akhmetov at 2 p.m.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Right — you had been working on it for weeks.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Exactly. I had prepared everything. The slides, the data, even the summary printout. But when I arrived at the office — the professor wasn't there.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: He had been called to an emergency faculty meeting at 1:45. No one had told me. His assistant said she had tried to email me, but I hadn't checked.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Oh no. So what did you do?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I waited for an hour. Then his assistant came and said: "The professor will see you now." I went in. He apologised. Then he asked me to present — still in his coat.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Better than I'd expected, honestly. By the time I started speaking, I had calmed down. All the preparation I had done paid off.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: So after all that drama, it turned out OK?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Not just OK — he said it was one of the best student research presentations he had seen this year.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I can't believe it! After everything that had happened!

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I know. If I had known it would end like that, I wouldn't have panicked so much.
